title: Define 'actor' once and align roles with SMART Guidelines personas
requirements:
- Explain modelling an actor role as an Application Component as a deliberate IHE-compatible convention
- Use one set of terms across SMART Guidelines, this document and the knowledge graph
- Distinguish individuals, professional roles, organisations, devices and applications
- Include clinical coders and data analysts among the named actors
- Require a type/stereotype distinguishing reference component, actor role, national component, product and simulator
- Verify the persona example against current SMART Guidelines
- Extend actor modelling to accountability, consent, audit and safety
- Use 'application actor role' in 3.7 and distinguish it from human/organisational actors
